column3: Bilingual-pairing hash record: 6 heading paths (title/problem/decision/alternatives/verification/consequences) with en+zh hashes for the unify-agent-and-session-id note.

Decision note collapsing agent registry id and session id into one identity; Session.header.id is the single home, Session.id is derived, agents[].id stays a config label, fresh starts mint ${label}-session-${uuid}.
Chinese mirror of the unify-agent-and-session-id note, same sections and same mutually-exclusive exact-id-input rule; no new mechanism.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 6 heading paths for the one-send-one-turn note.
Decision note removing implicit send batching: one send = at most one turn, next turn waits for the previous turn/end plus durability checkpoint, steer/inject/cancel are carve-outs.
Chinese mirror of the one-send-one-turn note; same at-most-one-turn guarantee and steer/inject carve-outs.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 7 heading paths, adding the nested /snapshot-boundary path for the ACP note.
Decision note demoting ACP to an automation transport: committed semantic facts only, truthful image capability, one-shot machine permission channel, shared memoized quiescence boundary.
Chinese mirror of the ACP automation-only note, with an added <a id="snapshot-boundary"> anchor; same wire policy.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 6 heading paths for the synthetic-turn removal note.

Decision note deleting appendOutOfBand and synthetic turns: log-only events append between turns, ctx.sessions.flush is the explicit durability barrier, turn numbers now mean model-loop executions only.
Chinese mirror of the synthetic-turn removal note; same explicit session/flush barrier wording.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 6 heading paths for the schedule time-zone note.
Decision note keeping the browser time zone request-local (clientTimeZone on the RPC boundary) and forcing Schedule to accept only explicit absolute time; deletes all Session/persistence zone state.
Chinese mirror of the schedule time-zone note; same request-local boundary and DST gap/overlap rules.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 5 heading paths (no separate Verification section) for the JSONL-only persistence note.
Decision note making JSONL the sole first-party Session store and deleting the SQLite Session-persistence provider, while keeping the FTS5 query index and generic domain-KV roles distinct.
Chinese mirror of the JSONL-only persistence note; same three-way storage-role distinction.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 5 heading paths for the non-transactional loader note.

Decision note reverting transactional config reload: Loader mutates eagerly, no plugin rollback, consumers must audit activation after settlement, two upstream deviations kept for reproduced ENOENT and ESM race failures.
Chinese mirror of the non-transactional loader note; same two retained upstream deviations and same audit-after-settlement conclusion.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 8 heading paths, adding the nested /reintroduction-conditions path for the E2B removal note.
Decision note removing the E2B sandbox/filesystem/subprocess providers while keeping ctx.fs and ctx.subprocess async contracts; cites SDK retained-output growth as the removal reason.
Chinese mirror of the E2B removal note; same retained-output argument and POSIX SSH pointer.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 7 heading paths, adding the nested /decision/retained-decisions path for the unified activations note.

Decision note giving every subagent provider one startActivation() entry point, one ownership/capacity graph and one parent-owned catalog; parent notices carry final text regardless of send_message use.
Chinese mirror of the unified activations note; same accept-duplication rationale for parent notices.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 6 heading paths for the Desktop profile-cleanup removal note.
Decision note deleting the Desktop production profile core-package cleanup so launches stop writing into the profile; nearest-wins resolution and peer-dependency packaging rule replace it.
Chinese mirror of the Desktop profile-cleanup removal note; same nearest-wins and peer-dependency rules.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 5 heading paths for the Team-inbox note.

Decision note deleting the Team outbox: sends go through the target agent's inbox and return a MessageId or throw, with no retry-after-restart promise and historical mail left decodable but undelivered.
Chinese mirror of the Team-inbox note; same single-identity single-owner outcome.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 5 heading paths for the native-or-PTC presentation note.
Decision note giving each agent exactly one tool-invocation form (native or ptc) and having the registry reject the both configuration instead of silently mapping it.
Chinese mirror of the native-or-PTC note; same registry rejection and upgrade-guide pointer.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 5 heading paths for the preset-owned subagent composition note.
Decision note letting Agent Presets own child persona and tools, rejecting the removed persona/toolFilter keys at load, and explicitly declining to claim a provider cache-hit improvement.
Chinese mirror of the preset-owned composition note; same unmeasured prompt-cost and cache-hit caveat.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 17 heading paths (densest in the shard), tracking every ### subsection of the CI note plus its three Security subsections.

Decision note making real-API e2e a merge signal in a separate secret-bearing workflow, with a fail-loud preflight, step-scoped secret env, author-based Dependabot gate and a full fork/going-public threat model.
Chinese mirror of the real-API CI note; same preflight, step-scoped secret and fork/Dependabot threat model.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 15 heading paths, including the nested /decision/scaffold-apps-web-tests-scaffold-ts path.

Decision note for the keyless browser e2e lane: recorded session-log replay through the real web composition, explicit whenIdle-then-settled-poll barrier stack, banned networkidle, failure on any pageerror, and a ReplayHandle.assertConsumed teardown tripwire.
Chinese mirror of the keyless browser e2e lane note; same two-stage barrier stack and networkidle ban.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 5 heading paths for the reasoning-chunk stress note.

Decision note coalescing streaming publication to one requestAnimationFrame while folding every raw chunk into State, rejecting microtask batching, and adding an opt-in 100,000-chunk browser stress lane.
Chinese mirror of the reasoning-chunk stress note; same microtask-batching rejection and 100,000-chunk workload.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 9 heading paths; the /decision entry has identical en and zh hashes because both blocks are empty (hash covers a section's own text, not its subsections).

Decision note validating the installed wheel and packaged executable on every native target, with an installed-artifact identity check that runs before the first agent request and a two-turn live-provider sentinel-file test.
Chinese mirror of the installed-wheel CI note; same identity-check list and two-turn sentinel test.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 7 heading paths, adding the /invariants and /risks paths for the snapshot corpus note.

Decision note reserving snapshots/ and *.snapshot.ts for recorded-session scenarios launched through dsh, with a typed redaction map, OS-assigned loopback ports, generation retention rules and an explicit Risks section.
Chinese mirror of the snapshot corpus note; same port-0 atomic-bind rationale and redaction-fixed-point framing.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 7 heading paths, adding the nested /calibration-evidence/indexed-traversal-of-stored-json-arrays path.

Decision note for the required Session-open benchmark gate: separate first-open and reopen access kinds, four phase budgets plus end-to-end budgets, post-GC retained heap, a 128 MB constrained-heap mode, and budgets calibrated against positive and negative controls.
Chinese mirror of the Session-open performance gate; same budget table and indexed-traversal results.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 6 heading paths for the continuation baseline note.

Decision note baselining tool-heavy backend continuation across four cases (request history, tool continuation, shipped SDK workflow, child catalog) with a request-counter-only adapter, sequential input, and measured retained heap.
Chinese mirror of the continuation baseline; same request-counter rule and retained-heap protocol.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 9 heading paths, adding three nested /calibration/... subsection paths.

Decision note for calibrated browser budgets: 240-turn input with production-built compact streams, two-animation-frame completion witnesses, scoped observers, and a Trajectory readiness fix that changes the observer rather than the budget.
Chinese mirror of the frontend budgets note; same endpoint table and observer-vs-product-latency findings.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 5 heading paths for the local updater qualification note.

Decision note qualifying Desktop update downloads against an isolated loopback server with the real Electron executor and NsisUpdater, including the Electron-44 close-before-headers rule and window-visibility assertion.
Chinese mirror of the local updater qualification note; same Electron-44 rule and visibility assertion requirement.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 5 heading paths for the update-journal note.
Decision note keeping update evidence across an installed-update restart via an opt-in JSONL journal that whitelists fields rather than redacting secrets, with fixed error classifications.
Chinese mirror of the update-journal note; same whitelist-over-redaction decision and propagating storage failures.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 5 heading paths for the update-materials note.

Decision note isolating installed-update materials: derived test versions, shared private identity, receipt-based feed publication, real-verifier signature checks and a package verifier that extracts the signed installer.
Chinese mirror of the update-materials note; same receipt-reuse rule and no-PUT-no-upload-failure caution.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 6 heading paths, adding the /deferred path for the observed-state note.
Decision note anchoring bounded waits at the mocked launcher's hand-over instead of a wall-clock window, and putting a full per-send readiness timeline into the failure message.
Chinese mirror of the observed-state note; same hand-over anchoring and ConPTY repaint evidence.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 6 heading paths for the Git child-environment note.
Decision note isolating the specs from the host's GIT_CONFIG_COUNT group, treating counter and keys as one unit, and deferring the product-side scrub to a named branch.
Chinese mirror of the Git child-environment note; same unit analysis and named deferred branch.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 6 heading paths for the spreadsheet-selection note.
Decision note diagnosing four executions of a geometry-bound handleCellAreaMouseDown updater and replacing the pointer click with a keyboard selection computed from committed state.
Chinese mirror of the spreadsheet-selection note; same four-execution signature and keyboard replacement.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 9 heading paths, adding the nested /decision/{workload,corpus-construction,measured-endpoints} paths.
Decision note baselining corpus-scale list, search and fork using quantile anchors taken from one developer's 1,650 Sessions, with a five-minute hosted-CI file limit and explicit exclusions.
Chinese mirror of the corpus baseline; same quantile anchor table and hosted-to-reference ratio of 2.4-3.4.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 8 heading paths, adding the nested /decision/cases and /decision/limit-and-endpoint paths.
Decision note rerunning selected benchmark files inside a cgroup v2 capped at 4 or 8 GiB with swap disabled, and explaining why heap flags and RLIMIT_AS cannot model the machine.
Chinese mirror of the memory-limited benchmark note; same cgroup setup and three measurement columns.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 8 heading paths, adding three nested /decision/... paths for the scaled benchmark report.
Decision note writing a self-contained HTML report that scales measured medians onto reviewed machine profiles using a measured storage/CPU split and shows peak RSS as a share of 4 and 8 GB.
Chinese mirror of the scaled benchmark report; same scaling formula and estimates-not-measurements caveat.
Bilingual-pairing hash record with 10 heading paths, adding four nested /decision/... paths for the credential-matching note.

Decision note making credential detection linear via a literal-only native scan, per-hit constant-time decisions and a per-text Int32Array memo, with the benchmark used as a rejection oracle against the regex implementation.
Chinese mirror of the credential-matching note; same algorithm-cost table and rejection-oracle property.
